title: Thu 15 Oct 2026: Hot US CPI, Asian chip rout, BoE hike bets, FCA illiquid fund proposals
summary: American inflation rises to three point seven percent, Wall Street has its worst day in two months and the Kospi halts trading in an Asian chip rout. A Bank of England hike on 5 November is close to fully priced ahead of the 28 October Budget. In regulation, the AIFM consultation closes on 22 October, the FCA proposes ninety-day notice for illiquid-asset funds, Connect starts on 2 November, and ESMA names a new chair. Plus three COO action points and the diary.
